public.text: The equity discussion focuses primarily on unrepresentative training data. Inequity may also arise from deployment context, access, workflow, language, disability, connectivity, user behaviour, and differential consequences of error.
public.suggestedRevision: Expand equity assessment across the full lifecycle, including problem selection, data, design, access, deployment, oversight, outcomes, redress, and withdrawal.
